n:99001533.d: former bridge in Midland County, Michigan, United States
f: Ball Rd. over Little Salt Creek, Jasper Township

ph.alt: Ruins of the Ball Rd. Bridge

wx: The Ball Road-Little Salt Creek Bridge, also known as simply the Ball Road Bridge, was a bridge carrying Ball Road over Little Salt Creek in Jasper Township, Michigan. It was listed on the National Register of Historic Places in 1999.
